verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a merchant Dashboard could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server is a separate capability: it lets external AI agents in the user's IDE query the docs and run payment operations, but it is not an assistant inside the product. Agentic commerce via ChatGPT and Google AI is a customer checkout channel, and AI-driven acceptance optimization is an automated backend feature; neither is a delegable in-product assistant.
